id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1818: "Oh... you're a traveler, aren't you. And a skilled one, by the look of it. You needn't say a word.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18c8: "This land was once called Hauksness. It was destroyed by monsters long ago and left without a single soul, but...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1994: "Somehow, by someone's hand, the Demon Knight who dwelled in this town has revived.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a34: "The Demon Knight roused the dead who slept in peace and now rules this entire town...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aec: "Please, traveler. Won't you defeat the Demon Knight so these people can sleep in peace?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c20: "...I see. But you're the only one who can save this town. Come again if you change your mind.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d34: "Oh, thank you. The Demon Knight is said to appear behind the weapon shop in the southeast of town.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ddc: "Please defeat the Demon Knight so these people may sleep in peace. I pray for your success.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fac: "Please defeat the Demon Knight so these people may sleep in peace. I pray for your success.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ef8: "The Demon Knight ruling Hauksness is said to appear behind the weapon shop in the southeast of town.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2154: "Oh, traveler. You defeated the Demon Knight. Peace has come to the town.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2204: "Please accept this small token of thanks from me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2288: "Thanks to you finding me, the people of Hauksness were saved. Now everyone can sleep in peace.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2350: "My name is Garin. I was a bard who once traveled this land of Alefgard.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23fc: "Long ago, Hauksness here was a truly lively town.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|245c: "If I close my eyes, scenes from those days rise before me. Come, you too, close your eyes.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25a4: "This town was once attacked by many monsters. Those unlucky enough to be left behind all died by their hands.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2698: "Yes, we are already dead. For some reason, we were suddenly woken from our sleep.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2748: "And then the Demon Knight began to rule this town. How utterly vile.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|284c: "This is the item shop, but we gave everything to the Demon Knight, so there's nothing to sell.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28f0: "Sob... being made a monster's minion even after death. This is truly a living hell...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a14: "The Demon Knight comes into town and demands our obedience. If we defy him, something terrible happens...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ad8: "He often appears around the back of Yukinofu's shop, but he seems to be out on patrol now.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c38: "This is the weapon and armor shop my friend Yukinofu ran.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cc0: "When monsters attacked this town, Yukinofu barely managed to escape with his family...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d7c: "I was too late to flee and was killed by monsters. Even now in death, I'm made to work for them... sigh...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e80: "Oh... could you be the one who'll defeat the Demon Knight and free us?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2efc: "The Demon Knight often appears behind here. Be very careful.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ff8: "How much time has passed since we failed to protect this town and monsters destroyed it...?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30a8: "That we, destroyed by monsters, now serve monsters even in death... How regrettable...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31d8: "The Demon Knight makes us work all night long. I'd like to rest, even a little.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3274: "We're already dead, so we won't die from lack of sleep, but... it's so hard I could break.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3384: "Just before this town was destroyed, I saw Yukinofu burying something at the base of a tree behind his shop.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3468: "What could it have been? But the town fell years ago, so someone must have taken it away by now.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35b0: "This used to be an inn, but we no longer have beds fit for guests...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3664: "A life like this, I'd rather be dead. Well, we are already dead, destroyed by monsters...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|376c: "Oh... traveler. The Demon Knight appears behind the weapon shop, so it's dangerous to approach carelessly.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3828: "For some reason, he's obsessed with that spot. As if guarding something he lost...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39a0: "Getting worn out by this little heat? They're all so sloppy!

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a0c: "But I can't just leave them behind. Maybe teaming up with these people was a mistake...

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4718: "It's terribly cold, though! Bare legs couldn't take this cold, so I'm glad I wore tights!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5314: "Thanks to you defeating the monster, I can look for the Padequia seed. Thank you so much!

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|53c0: "With the seed, Kiryl's illness should be cured. I just can't get going without him healthy.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5494: "...But it's strange. No matter which sliding floor I step on, I end up in a similar place...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5550: "Could that floor be broken? I don't have time for this. How annoying!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e30: "...Traveler, listen. This cave is normally very cold, and has a precious seed called the Padequia seed.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5efc: "We went deep with Princess Alena, at the front, to get that seed, but suddenly a monster wreathed in flame appeared.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6014: "And then... the ice in the cave began to melt and the temperature rose and rose.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|60b8: "We tried to fight the monster anyway, but with this heat... we couldn't bear it and fled back here.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|616c: "If the heat-sensitive Padequia seed is left like that, it will be useless. We must defeat the monster and fix this heat...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6258: "...Traveler, sorry to ask so suddenly, but we're exhausted. Could you defeat the monster for us?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|63cc: "...I see. Then it can't be helped. We'll have to go ourselves. But in this heat... ugh...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|651c: "Thank you, traveler! The flame-wreathed monster is at the very back! If you beat it, we'll thank you properly!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|65f4: "...Oh, one more favor. If you find the Padequia seed, please don't pick it up.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a44: "...Oh, one more favor. If you find the Padequia seed, please don't pick it up.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6690: "Princess Alena is looking for the Padequia seed to cure a man named Kiryl.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ae0: "Princess Alena is looking for the Padequia seed to cure a man named Kiryl.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6740: "She insists on getting it by her own power, so we want to let her take it. Sorry.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b90: "She insists on getting it by her own power, so we want to let her take it. Sorry.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68c4: "If the heat-sensitive Padequia seed is left like this, it will be useless...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6960: "To fix this heat, defeat the flame-wreathed monster at the very back. If you do, we'll thank you properly.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d30: "Brrr... h-hello, traveler. You defeated the flame-wreathed monster. Th-thank you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e68: "Now we can find the Padequia seed and save Princess Alena's friend! Thank you so much!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f14: "B-but it's terribly cold. Well, it would be a disaster if the seed wilted from heat, so this is fine...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fc0: "Well, we'll head deeper into the cave. Please leave the cave and continue your journey... brrr.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70f4: "H-hello, we meet again, traveler. We're having trouble with the sliding floors and can't get ahead...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|71b4: "The road to the Padequia seed is much longer than I thought.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|722c: "...By the way, you've been a great help. Please leave the cave and continue your journey.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|736c: "I travel to save the world from the Emperor of Hell, I do.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|73ec: "But, but... it's hot here! Unusually so! I can't move another step, I say!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74d8: "I-I travel to save the world from the Emperor of Hell, I do.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|767c: "I-I travel to save the world from the Emperor of Hell, I do.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7564: "B-but it's worse than expected! This cold chills to the bone! The heat was better, I say!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7708: "Wandering this freezing cave, I've lost count of how many times I've come to this spot.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|77b4: "At this rate, body and soul will truly freeze...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|78bc: "I heard the cave was very cold, so wearing a fur coat was a mistake.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|795c: "Sigh... why is Princess Alena at the front fine? She doesn't seem human.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b00: "Sigh... why is Princess Alena at the front fine? She doesn't seem human.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a5c: "Brr, cold... ah, cold. My sweat-soaked fur coat has frozen solid.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c00: "Sigh... Princess Alena at the front has been walking in the same place and doesn't seem to notice...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7cb4: "As long as she's in front, we'll never reach the Padequia seed... ugh.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e10: The king looks at you⏎as if wanting to say something.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ed0: "Now I can once again give the hero a revival password as before. You've been a great help.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7f88: "By the way... would you like to hear your revival password once more?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|801c: "Hmm... I see. Come anytime you wish to hear it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|80fc: "...Yes! My revival passwords have regained their sharpness. I am truly grateful, traveler!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|81d4: "A revival password is the record of your journey itself. Cherish each memory of your travels so you don't forget them.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8320: "Oh, what shall I do... why has Father suffered this fate...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|84a8: "Oh, traveler, thank you for coming. I am Princess Gwaelin of Tantegel. Please hear me out.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8584: "The other day, a self-styled Destroyer of Time appeared before my father, King of Tantegel, and cursed him mute.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|86a4: "Father is the only one who can give revival passwords in this land. As it stands, the hero cannot continue his journey.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8794: "I tried every medicine and spell in the castle to help Father, but nothing seems to cure him.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|888c: "Only one way remains. Rainbow nectar, said to give you a seven-colored voice with a single spoonful.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|895c: "According to old legend, Rainbow nectar can only be obtained by one who brings true peace to the world...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8f88: "According to old legend, Rainbow nectar can only be obtained by one who brings true peace to the world...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8a38: "When you bring peace not just to this world but to yours too, perhaps it can be obtained.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9064: "When you bring peace not just to this world but to yours too, perhaps it can be obtained.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8afc: "Please, traveler. If you find Rainbow nectar, won't you give it to Gwaelin?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8cf4: "Oh! I never thought someone would accept such a request!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8d74: "There are only faint clues, but you, who can travel between two worlds, surely can find it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8e38: "If you obtain Rainbow nectar, please bring it to me. I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9128: "If you obtain Rainbow nectar, please bring it to me. I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9240: "Traveler... you came from a faraway place called Erdrea, didn't you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|92e0: "If you use the revival password from before and remember us, Gwaelin would be happy.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9428: "Hm, an unfamiliar face. This is the castle of Tantegel, the kingdom at the center of Alefgard.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|94c4: "The king can't speak now. Sorry you came all this way, but please hold off on an audience for a while.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|95d8: "This is Tantegel Castle, the heart of Alefgard. Over there are the King of Tantegel and Princess Gwaelin.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9678: "Princess Gwaelin was held captive for a long time by the Dragonlord who ruled this land, but the hero rescued her.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|97b0: "The hero descends from the great Erdrick. He set out to defeat the Dragonlord and restore light to this land.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|98d4: "The king's revival passwords are indispensable to the hero's adventure. We are truly grateful to you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9a10: "Of all things, such a calamity befell the king... How pitiful.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9adc: "If the king's voice doesn't return, the hero won't be able to continue his journey safely.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9b8c: "If anything happened to the hero, how Princess Gwaelin would grieve...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9c78: "But who is this Destroyer of Time who cursed the king?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9d0c: "To sneak into the castle boldly and harm the king, what a frightening fellow.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9e34: "Just when Princess Gwaelin was saved, now the king suffers this. Is this kingdom cursed?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9f4c: "How long has it been since the king lost his voice...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9fb8: "The king must be suffering greatly. Traveler! Please grant Princess Gwaelin's request!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a0bc: "From now on, we'll guard the king well so he isn't cursed again.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a154: "We never want Princess Gwaelin to feel such sorrow again.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a2d8: "Oh, traveler, please listen. This is a town of old tales, bearing the name of the great bard Garin.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a3ac: "The other day, monsters suddenly came, sneaked into Garin's grave, and stole his keepsake, the Silver harp.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a48c: "The Silver harp is no mere keepsake. Once strummed, its tone is an eerie item that draws monsters.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a548: "The monster strums the Silver harp in this town, endlessly drawing monsters here... Everyone in town fled.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a630: "At this rate, the town will be destroyed... Please defeat the monster that stole the Silver harp and bring peace back to town.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a798: "Oh, I see... Then I too shall resolve to perish along with this town...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a8d0: "Oh, thank you! The monster that stole the Silver harp is hiding somewhere in this town.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a968: "Even in places that look dark, a path hides. Search the town well.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|abf8: "Even in places that look dark, a path hides. Search the town well.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aa20: "The town is overflowing with monsters drawn by the harp's tune, so be careful. I pray for your success...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|acb0: "The town is overflowing with monsters drawn by the harp's tune, so be careful. I pray for your success...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ab84: "The monster that stole the Silver harp is hiding somewhere in this town.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|add8: "Oh, traveler. You got the Silver harp back. Please hand it over.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ae90: "It's an important keepsake left by the late Garin for this town. Please return it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aff8: "The townspeople who fled in fear of monsters will return now. Here, this is my thanks.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b0bc: "I'll return this Silver harp, with Garin's memories, to the depths of his grave as it was.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b178: "Traveler, thanks to you the Silver harp can be preserved for posterity. Thank you truly.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b2b0: "Traveler, thanks to you the Silver harp can be preserved for posterity. The townspeople have returned safely.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b388: "Oh, about the Silver harp, I've returned it to Garin's grave as it was.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b3fc: "I wonder whether the hero who will someday appear can obtain the Silver harp. I'd like to test that. Ho ho ho.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b534: "I hate men. But you seem kind, so I don't dislike you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b5e0: "If you like, you can stay in this town forever.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b69c: "From now on we must keep a close watch so Garin's grave isn't disturbed.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b710: "So I'm busy. If you want to ask about the town, ask the one next to me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b894: "So I'm busy. If you want to ask about the town, ask the one next to me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b80c: "From now on we must keep a close watch so no monsters get into town.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b974: "In the old days I traveled all the way to Hauksness, far to the south. I was young then.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ba84: "Oh, are you the one who saved this town? Oh, take it, thief! Everything here is my property!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bb50: "Without you, I might have lost my life by now! I won't be stingy with thanks!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bc40: "Rumor has it Erdrick's armor is in some town. I'd like to see it once.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bd2c: "I thought I could no longer live in this town... but thanks to you, I can live as before.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|be38: "This town, said to be made by the great bard Garin, must never be seized by monsters again.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bf04: "Thank you, nameless youth. We'll keep protecting Garin's name.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bfe4: "Oh, aren't you this town's savior! Please, take your time!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c0b4: "Shopping? Sorry. I'm checking my stock to see whether monsters stole any.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c1cc: "Oh dear, sorry. Monsters ransacked us, so the shop will be closed a while longer.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c2cc: "Welcome to Garin, the town of old tales!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c30c: "Oh, I never thought I'd say this greeting again! Thank you so much!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c3f4: "I heard a rumor that the hero has left Tantegel Castle.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c49c: "Will the hero stop by this town soon?! I'm so curious I can't get anything done.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c698: "Oh! You look skilled! I'm a soldier of Midenhall. I was looking for a traveler like you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c750: "A monster suddenly appeared and stole precious treasures from this cave, and we're in trouble.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c824: "The Emblem of Life, Erdrick's Armor, the Sword of Lightning... The monster wanders the cave wearing all three.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c8fc: "The three treasures help the Prince of Midenhall on his journey. We must get them back from the monster.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c9e8: "Please, traveler. Defeat that Wandering Erdrick's Armor and return the treasures to their place.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cb30: "Oh... I see. But I can't possibly win alone... ugh, what should I do...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc34: "Oh! Thank you! If you defeat the Wandering Erdrick's Armor, we can get the three treasures back.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ccd8: "The Wandering Erdrick's Armor seems to move all around the cave. Be careful when you search.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ce6c: "The Wandering Erdrick's Armor seems to move all around the cave. Be careful when you search.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cdec: "If you defeat the Wandering Erdrick's Armor, we can get the three treasures back.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cfd4: "Traveler, I've been waiting! You beat the Wandering Erdrick's Armor and returned the precious treasures!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d0ac: "Now the Prince of Midenhall can challenge the High Priest Hargon. Here, a token of thanks.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d164: "I'll keep watching here so the Emblem of Life, Erdrick's Armor and Sword of Lightning don't fall into evil hands.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d24c: "...By the way, your eyes shine with a sense of justice. Somehow they resemble the Prince of Midenhall's.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d33c: "Thanks to you, the Prince of Midenhall can continue his journey. I don't know how to thank you...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d3f4: "By the way, your eyes shine with a sense of justice. Somehow they resemble the Prince of Midenhall's.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d5e0: "I am... the princess of Moonbrooke, the country that once ruled this continent.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d670: "High Priest Hargon's agents burned Moonbrooke Castle... and I was turned into a dog.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d76c: "Then I was sent to this town of Moonpeta and spent my days aimlessly as a dog...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d800: "Lately someone disrupted the curse, and I became human again while my people became dogs.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d900: "Not only did everyone lose their castle, but my curse made my people suffer... I want to at least lift their curse.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d9ec: "...In the days of the hero Erdrick, there was a spell called Shanak that lifted curses.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|daa4: "It's an advanced spell I can't cast, but with holy water called magic holy water, I might manage it once.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|db80: "Please, traveler. Won't you look for magic holy water to lift the curse that passed to my people?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dd30: "But to save the people of Moonpeta, you're the only one I can turn to. Please come again if you change your mind.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|de74: "Oh... thank you! I've only read about magic holy water in old books and never seen it with my own eyes.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|df34: "But a traveler who wanders the world surely knows of it. If you get it, please come to me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e0a4: "The only clue for casting Shanak... I've only read of magic holy water in old books and never seen it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e1b0: "But a traveler who wanders the world surely knows of it. If you get it, please bring it to me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e31c: "But a traveler who wanders the world surely knows of it. If you get it, please bring it to me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e564: "But a traveler who wanders the world surely knows of it. If you get it, please bring it to me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e4d0: "...I see. Magic holy water isn't something easily obtained after all.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e720: "Oh, how beautiful... such divine holy water, I'm almost afraid to use it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e7b0: "...What? In your world it's fairly common? Your world... could it be...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e860: "No... this is no time to talk leisurely. I must save the cursed people as soon as possible.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e934: "I'm an inexperienced caster, but with the magic holy water's power I should manage high-level spells.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ea10: "Thank you, traveler. Now the townspeople will be saved. I'll try it right away.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eb50: The Princess of Moonbrooke used {var:5}⏎and cast Shanak!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eba8: The princess's spell⏎spreads across the town...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ec18: "As expected, when an inexperienced caster like me casts it, I can only save the cursed ones. I can't erase the curse itself.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ed0c: "I will take this curse upon myself. If only my people can return to their forms, that's enough for me...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f2c0: The dog stares at you.⏎It seems to be holding something in its mouth.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f3b0: "What was I doing until now? I feel I was a dog for a long time, but was it a dream?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f4bc: "There's fur scattered everywhere. I just cleaned recently, so why?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f618: "...Oh, how strange. Looking at you reminds me of the Prince of Midenhall.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f744: "The raffle tickets I treasured were dug up and buried in a hole. Who on earth did this... sob.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f870: "Welcome to Moonpeta. This is a town where people meet people.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f8f0: "How strange. When I was dozing earlier, I felt I met you in a dream.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f9f8: "Dog footprints have appeared all over the shop before I knew it... Who played such a prank?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fb00: "I'm ashamed of myself! I was so terrified I fled from the castle.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fb94: "By now, Moonbrooke Castle must be... Ah, Princess!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fc38: "I hear a dog barking. It sounds dignified, yet sorrowful.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fd94: "Hmm... what job should I take? Young gals are the most appealing, after all...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fe34: "Wh-what are you...! ...Ah, did Rudolph's descendant tell you to defeat me and send you here?!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fee4: "I was sealed away for ages! Compared to my ruined youth, that curse was nothing!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ffc0: "To enjoy the rest of my life, I will be reborn anew! Or do you intend to fight me?!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|100b: "What, you won't fight? Then don't get in my way. I'm about to be reborn.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1017: "Hmph, how amusing! The power that once tormented Rudolph... I'll show it to you in full!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1039: "I'm the master of this house, Rudman. You are... {var:1}? Please hear me out for a moment.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1045: "Tomorrow a grand wedding is to be held in this town. We were making preparations.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1053: "I meant to finish before the young groom returned with the proof of marriage...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1063: "Suddenly a strange monster came and cursed us! Everyone in the house now looks like me!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1073: "I know that monster... My great-great-great-great...great-grandfather Rudolph made his living sealing monsters.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1082: "Probably one of the sealed monsters revived somehow. I don't know why the seal broke...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1090: "Anyway, unless we return to normal, the young man will end up marrying me! Could you defeat that monster?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10a7: "As I feared... You had eyes like that young man, so I thought you'd be reliable...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10bf: "Oh, you'll do it! Thank you, kind youth!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10c7: "...But the monster flew off somewhere after cursing us.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10d4: "...Wait. Someone said they heard the monster muttering. It might be a clue.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10e1: "Right! First, hear the story from the people here, then go to the monster.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10ed: "I'll follow after you. It wouldn't be right to leave it all to a young man. See you later!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1131: "I'll follow after you. It wouldn't be right to leave it all to a young man. See you later!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1104: "A monster came during wedding preparations and cursed everyone in the house to look like me, then flew off.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1118: "I don't know where it went, but what someone heard it mutter might be a clue.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1125: "So first hear the story from the people here, then go to the monster.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|114a: "Ha ha ha! How delightful! You beat it while I was getting ready! I've taken a liking to {var:1}!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1157: "Now we can finally start wedding preparations. Thanks to {var:1}, thank you!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1161: "This wedding is an important one to pass on our family treasure, the Sky Shield. It will surely be wonderful.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|116f: "I'd like {var:1} to attend, but I don't want to hold you up on your journey. I'll pray for your safe travels from here.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1184: "What, you say you like me?! That won't do! Think again.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1198: "Hm, it's settled! Your manly decisiveness... You're just the young man I thought you were.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11a5: "As thanks for your help, I unlocked the chest behind me, so take what's inside.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11b1: "If you want to rehearse again, don't hesitate to tell me. It's good practice for me too.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11bd: "Well, you've helped me a lot. Now I can face the real thing without nerves. Thank you, {var:1}!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11fe: "Well, you've helped me a lot. Now I can face the real thing without nerves. Thank you, {var:1}!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11cc: "Oh, {var:1}. Could you help with the rehearsal again?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11d8: "I see, you're busy now. If you want to rehearse again, don't hesitate to tell me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11e7: "Oh, you'll do it! Then let's begin the rehearsal right away!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11f5: "Hm, good work. If you want to rehearse again, don't hesitate to tell me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|121e: "I'm finally back to normal. Thanks to you, you worked hard. Thank you!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1227: "{var:1}, you're a traveler, aren't you. My childhood friend has been traveling for a purpose too.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1232: "When we were little, the two of us went ghost hunting. Ah, I want to go adventuring again...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1248: "Hee hee, this is fun somehow. I can't wait to find out who you'll choose.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|125a: "{var:1}, there's someone waiting for you too, right? Take good care of them.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1296: "{var:1}, there's someone waiting for you too, right? Take good care of them.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|126a: "That girl is a Killer Panther, my childhood friend's old pal. But she disappeared on the way here.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12a6: "That girl is a Killer Panther, my childhood friend's old pal. But she disappeared on the way here.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1279: "My monster tamer friend raised her, so she should be fine... but if you find a lost Killer Panther, tell me!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12b4: "She was raised by my monster tamer friend, but I'm still worried. Have you seen a lost Killer Panther?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12cb: "I see... I can only pray she comes back safely.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12de: "What, you saw a Killer Panther rampaging at a place called Rapan House?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12e5: "She isn't the type to rampage... Come to think of it, once she was separated from my friend and went wild.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12f6: "When they reunited, she attacked my friend, but when he showed my ribbon, she remembered the past and calmed down.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1305: "Try showing this ribbon to her! If it's her, she'll remember me and calm down.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|131c: "You can have the ribbon, {var:1}. I want to go myself, but I can't leave here now, so please.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1327: "Show my ribbon to the Killer Panther that appears at a place called Rapan House!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1336: "Listen! She came back! Did you use my ribbon, {var:1}?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1347: "I knew it! I'm so glad to see her safe. Thank you, {var:1}.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1356: "Oh, it wasn't you...? Then maybe my prayers reached the gods. Anyway, I'm glad she's safe.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|136c: "Phew, thank goodness. If I'd stayed in Father's form, I don't know what I would have done.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1376: "Now we just wait for him to return... Who will he choose? I'm getting nervous...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1387: "When the rehearsal is over, next is our real wedding... I'm getting nervous...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1396: "Thank you so much for indulging our whims. I'll pray for your safe journey.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13ae: "You're not bad. Defeating a monster that gave our ancestors trouble.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13b9: "You seem rather useful, so from now on I might let you work as my servant.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13c2: "But don't get cocky. My number one servant is already decided. You're number two, got it?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13d1: "Hey, what are you doing? Making me wait takes nerve. Hurry and choose someone and get this over with.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13e4: "...Still, that man is slow. Making me wait, what a servant. When he's back I'll punish him good.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13f9: "Thank you for helping us. If I hadn't returned to normal, I don't know what I would have done.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1419: "Thank you for helping us. If I hadn't returned to normal, I don't know what I would have done.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1402: "Because it's complicated, being in the master's form and taking care of the master.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1422: "Because it's complicated, being in the master's form and taking care of the master.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|140e: "Oh my, don't be silly, {var:1}. Don't tease an old woman.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1431: "I meant to go home after helping with the wedding, so why am I like this too... I can't go back to the village like this.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1440: "If I can't return to normal, my father will worry. He's not even in good health...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1455: "Dither... if everyone turns into Father, I can't tell who is who.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1460: "Um... the one over there is the real Father... Oh, or was it that one?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|146d: "I respect Father, but to think I'd turn into him too... Dither... what about the wedding...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1480: "How long must I stay in the form of an old man like Papa?! Change me back right now!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|148b: "Absolutely impossible. Me, turned into Papa. My usual clothes won't suit me... terrible.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14a7: "I heard the monster who cursed us murmur something as he left.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14b0: "If I go to the whatever temple where one can start a new life, I too can be reborn...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14bb: "I don't know what it means, but the monster probably went to that temple. Please be careful.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14d8: "Oh... you're a traveler. I have a request for one like you who wanders many lands.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14e4: "My son, the Prince of Cannock, set out to find the Prince of Midenhall to defeat Hargon, but...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14f2: "My son's figure suddenly vanished like smoke! No one has seen him since...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1501: "Please, traveler. Find my son, the Prince of Cannock, and bring him back to this castle.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1517: "...Hmm, I see. Ah, where is my son... I hope he's safe.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|152a: "Oh, thank you! My son bears the mission to travel with the Prince of Midenhall and the Princess of Moonbrooke.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1537: "According to castle folk, my son murmured as if raving that he felt a prince was in Yubar Village.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1583: "According to castle folk, my son murmured as if raving that he felt a prince was in Yubar Village.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1545: "And my son vanished from that person's sight like smoke. What happened to him...
